id.instruksi: Dua langkah terbentuknya fosil tertukar tempat. Tukar keduanya supaya urut dari makhluk tertimbun sampai fosil tersingkap.
id.amonit-mati: amonit mati dan tenggelam ke dasar laut
id.amonit-busuk: bagian lunak membusuk, cangkang spiral tertinggal
id.amonit-batu: lapisan lumpur menumpuk dan mengeras jadi batuan sedimen
id.amonit-singkap: ombak mengikis tebing, fosil amonit tersingkap
id.trilobit-mati: trilobit mati di dasar laut purba
id.trilobit-busuk: bagian lunak hancur, kulit kerasnya tertinggal
id.trilobit-mineral: mineral mengisi dan menggantikan kulit kerasnya
id.trilobit-singkap: penambang membelah batu, fosil trilobit terlihat
id.stegodon-mati: gajah purba mati di tepi sungai purba
id.stegodon-timbun: tubuhnya tertimbun lumpur dan pasir sungai
id.stegodon-busuk: daging membusuk, tulang dan gadingnya tertinggal
id.stegodon-batu: lapisan endapan menumpuk dan menjadi batuan sedimen
id.stegodon-mineral: mineral menggantikan tulang sedikit demi sedikit
id.stegodon-singkap: hujan mengikis tanah, petani menemukan gadingnya
id.pakis-gugur: daun pakis purba gugur ke rawa
id.pakis-batu: lumpur menumpuk dan memadat menjadi batu
id.pakis-cetak: daun hancur, tetapi cetakannya tertinggal di batu
id.pakis-singkap: batu dibelah, cetakan daun pakis terlihat
id.bulubabi-mati: bulu babi purba mati di laut dangkal
id.bulubabi-singkap: laut surut, batu kapur terkikis, fosil muncul di pantai
id.capung-mati: capung purba jatuh ke danau dan mati
id.capung-timbun: tubuhnya tertutup lumpur yang sangat halus
id.capung-batu: lapisan lumpur menekan dan menjadi batu serpih
id.capung-singkap: ahli fosil membelah batu serpih dan menemukannya
id.kepiting-busuk: bagian dalam membusuk, cangkang kerasnya tertinggal
id.kepiting-batu: lumpur menumpuk dan menjadi batuan sedimen
id.kepiting-singkap: sungai mengikis batuan, fosil kepiting tersingkap
id.siput-mati: siput laut purba mati di dasar laut
id.siput-batu: endapan menumpuk dan menjadi batu kapur
id.siput-singkap: hujan mengikis tebing, cangkang siput terlihat
id.buaya-mati: buaya purba mati di tepi sungai
id.buaya-busuk: daging membusuk, tulang dan giginya tertinggal
id.buaya-batu: lapisan lumpur memadat menjadi batuan sedimen
id.buaya-singkap: pekerja jalan menggali bukit, fosil buaya ditemukan
id.tengkorak-mati: manusia purba meninggal di dekat sungai purba
id.tengkorak-timbun: tubuhnya tertimbun pasir dan abu gunung api
id.tengkorak-batu: lapisan menumpuk dan menjadi batuan sedimen
id.tengkorak-singkap: sungai mengikis tebing, tengkorak fosil ditemukan

en.instruksi: Two steps in how a fossil forms have swapped places. Swap them back, from the creature being buried to the fossil being uncovered.
en.amonit-mati: an ammonite dies and sinks to the sea floor
en.amonit-timbun: its shell is buried in mud
en.amonit-busuk: the soft parts rot and the spiral shell remains
en.amonit-batu: the mud layers pile up and harden into sedimentary rock
en.amonit-singkap: waves wear away the cliff and the ammonite is uncovered
en.trilobit-mati: a trilobite dies on an ancient sea floor
en.trilobit-timbun: its body is covered in fine sand
en.trilobit-busuk: the soft parts break down and the hard shell stays
en.trilobit-batu: the sand packs down into sedimentary rock
en.trilobit-mineral: minerals fill in and replace the hard shell
en.trilobit-singkap: a quarry worker splits the rock and the trilobite appears
en.stegodon-mati: an ancient elephant dies beside an ancient river
en.stegodon-timbun: its body is buried by river mud and sand
en.stegodon-busuk: the flesh rots and its bones and tusks remain
en.stegodon-batu: layers of sediment pile up and become sedimentary rock
en.stegodon-mineral: minerals replace the bones bit by bit
en.stegodon-singkap: rain wears away the soil and a farmer finds the tusk
en.pakis-gugur: an ancient fern leaf falls into a swamp
en.pakis-timbun: the leaf is covered in fine mud
en.pakis-batu: the mud piles up and hardens into rock
en.pakis-cetak: the leaf breaks down but its print stays in the rock
en.pakis-singkap: the rock is split and the fern print can be seen
en.bulubabi-mati: an ancient sea urchin dies in shallow sea
en.bulubabi-timbun: it is buried by sand and broken coral
en.bulubabi-busuk: the spines fall off and the round shell remains
en.bulubabi-singkap: the sea retreats, the limestone wears away and the fossil appears on the shore
en.capung-mati: an ancient dragonfly falls into a lake and dies
en.capung-timbun: its body is covered by very fine mud
en.capung-batu: the mud layers press down and become shale
en.capung-cetak: the shape of its wings is recorded in the rock
en.capung-singkap: a fossil hunter splits the shale and finds it
en.kepiting-mati: an ancient crab dies in an estuary
en.kepiting-timbun: it is buried in estuary mud
en.kepiting-busuk: the insides rot and its hard shell remains
en.kepiting-batu: the mud piles up and becomes sedimentary rock
en.kepiting-singkap: a river wears away the rock and the crab fossil is uncovered
en.s-siput: A snail in a limestone cliff
en.siput-mati: an ancient sea snail dies on the sea floor
en.siput-timbun: its shell is buried in lime mud
en.siput-batu: the mud piles up and becomes limestone
en.siput-angkat: the sea floor is lifted up into dry land
en.siput-singkap: rain wears away the cliff and the snail shell shows
en.buaya-mati: an ancient crocodile dies on a riverbank
en.buaya-timbun: a flood buries its body in mud
en.buaya-busuk: the flesh rots and its bones and teeth remain
en.buaya-batu: the mud layers harden into sedimentary rock
en.buaya-singkap: road workers dig into a hill and find the crocodile fossil
en.tengkorak-mati: an early human dies near an ancient river
en.tengkorak-timbun: the body is buried by sand and volcanic ash
en.tengkorak-busuk: the soft parts break down and the skull remains
en.tengkorak-batu: the layers pile up and become sedimentary rock
en.tengkorak-mineral: minerals slowly replace the skull bone
en.tengkorak-singkap: a river wears away the bank and the fossil skull is found
